hook: The Day Lincoln Asked America to Give Thanks
text: On the third of October, eighteen hundred and sixty-three, a proclamation was issued in Lincoln's name. It spoke of the year that was drawing to its close, and how it had been filled with the blessings of fruitful fields and healthful skies. And it invited the people of the United States, in every part of the country, to set apart and observe the last Thursday of November as a day of Thanksgiving and Praise. That year, the last Thursday of November fell on the twenty-sixth. And from that year to this, Americans have kept a national Thanksgiving Day every year.
